about_short_description.short_description: Atopile is a software company that develops tools for crafting electronic circuit board designs using code.

product.name: ato Language
product.description: A domain-specific language for describing electronic circuit designs with code, including components, interfaces, units, tolerances, and constraints.

product.name: ato Compiler
product.description: A command-line tool that compiles ato code to update PCB designs, manage dependencies, and generate manufacturing files.

product.name: Component Creation Tool
product.description: An embedded tool to generate ato code templates for electronic components, supporting JLCPCB parts and manufacturer data.

product.name: Package Management System
product.description: A system to find, install, manage, and synchronize reusable ato code modules and dependencies for circuit design projects.

product.name: Layout Integration with KiCad
product.description: Integration with KiCad to generate, open, and synchronize PCB layout files from ato code, including a KiCad plugin for layout assistance.

identifier.value: Version Control and Continuous Integration Support

product.name: Version Control and Continuous Integration Support
product.description: Guidance and tools for using git version control and CI pipelines to manage, build, test, and validate circuit design projects.
